messages:
leah.pm: Quick update: we
re opening a limited private preview for GH200 Dedicated capacity in us-west-3 (Oakland). Intended for customers needing large HBM and NVLink scale for very large-context inference and hybrid train/infer workflows.

toni.eng: Tech summary: hosts are 4x GH200-64GB boards with our NUMA-aware allocator and updated NVLink topology. Early internal benchmarks show substantial HBM bandwidth improvements for KV-heavy models vs A100-based hosts.

toni.eng: Preview limits: per-tenant cap = 1 host by default. Multi-host trials require support approval. KV shard balancing enabled. Disable speculative quantization for preview jobs.

nate.ops: Rollout: pool gh200-us-oak-preview created, initial capacity small (3 hosts). Preview is soft-launch with no uptime SLA; GA planned in ~30 days subject to stability and cost review. Billing tag: preview-gh200.

billing-bot: [billing-note] tag applied: preview-gh200 to pool gh200-us-oak-preview by nate.ops at 2026-04-09T15:12:00Z

ana.sales: Sales note: limited seats. Ana will send AE guidance and a canned email template to handle access requests and set expectations on quota and performance.

toni.eng: Ops checklist:
- Add gh200-us-oak-preview routing with fallback to a100-us-west and l4-us-west.
- Enforce per-tenant host cap = 1 for preview.
- Monitor HBM utilization and KV cache OOMs closely.

leah.pm: Action items: Toni monitor perf, Nate publish weekly capacity snapshots, Ana prepare AE comms, Billing hold GA pricing. Post customer signup requests in this thread.

nate.ops: FYI: pool health will be posted to #eng-ops; tagging here for critical issues.

toni.eng: If you see OOMs or kernel timeouts, include job-id + sample input and tag @toni.eng.

leah.pm: Thanks team 
 will follow up with a short FAQ and the preview access form link in the next 12 hours.
